item.title: Leave a Note About a Broken Cup
item.prompt_text: You broke Maya's red cup. You have put a clean white cup by the kettle for her to use. Write a short note to say what happened, where the white cup is, and when you will buy a new red cup.
item.target_grammar: Past simple for the accident, by for place, and will for a promise.
item.target_structure: Apologise, say where to look, then name the day you will replace it.

checklist.point: Say where the white cup is.
Give a time for replacing it.
